AllocationInput.description: Before-container allocation facts. No container or cgroup qualification is inferred.

CleanupEvidence.description: Raw observations from the trusted host helper, interpreted only by Rust.

process_group_probe_errno.description: kill(-owned_pgid, 0) must return ESRCH after reap/removal.

CleanupInput.description: One bounded JSON stdin request to the trusted independent runtime cleanup entry.

exists_exit.description: Native podman container exists exact-ID status: 1 absent, 125 error.

sweep_ids.description: Label-filtered sweep may only account for the retained exact container.

Forcing.description: A forced reproduction (#393): the declarative condition the harness applies, outside the test, to recreate a flake. Only on demonstrating checks.

ImageIdentity.description: Prepared by the runtime builder from the ops inventory, never a compiled digest catalog.

LaunchContext.description: Host-runner plumbing, not scheduler attestation or own-cgroup qualification.

Liveness.description: One bounded on-demand observation at the existing scheduled Look boundary, never a poller.

NativeProgress.description: Persisted before the event callback. Historical progress never proves current liveness.

Options.description: Provisioned access only. URI is deliberately separate from instance generation.

PrepareBundleInput.description: Rust-owned input to immutable pre-submit bundle publication. FXR supplies raw files only.

RedClass.description: The RED class accepted for an observer (#926, tessera #1455).

oneOf.description: The base failure did not satisfy the declared RED reason (#848).

RunnerReport.description: Trusted host-runner envelope. Daytime payload is judged by the existing harness.

RuntimeBindingInput.description: Raw facts collected outside the test runner's stdout. Rust interprets them.

RuntimeOwnership.description: Retained before starting repository code. Immutable across cleanup retries.

active_state.description: systemd inactive/dead or unit-not-found, never an arbitrary boolean.

cgroup_events.description: None means the retained cgroup path is authoritatively absent.

WorkerPayload.description: Transport-only retained worker protocol. Existing worker semantic validators remain authoritative.
